gen-tourney-gf-cal-sans: Wide-tracked, hefty and cut at a single stroke width, Tourney shouts like a stadium scoreboard. Cal Sans is the quieter half, with short ascenders and a tall x-height that make it friendly and easy to settle into.
gen-tourney-gf-carlito: Carlito reads round and open, with big lowercase letters and small-looking capitals sitting close together. Tourney's bulky display shapes sit above it, and the tight spacing keeps text moving smoothly, the way sans-serif copy should.
gen-tourney-gf-changa: Changa gives its lowercase the stature of cast iron capitals, which makes it feel sturdy and modern. Changa carries the text with that muscle, while Tourney's wide-tracked, uniform strokes handle the loud, athletic work up top.
gen-tourney-gf-courier-prime: Courier Prime reads like a drafting pen at work, with lowercase filling most of the height and generous round mouths. And Tourney's stretched, uniform letters make a loud contrast, so the monospace text feels even more orderly.
gen-tourney-gf-days-one: Days One packs an x-height that fills the line, with spacing like rungs on a rope ladder, against Tourney's marker-nib strokes. Tourney stretches wide and shouts.
gen-tourney-gf-epunda-sans: Neutral and open, Epunda Sans gives its e and a counters plenty of daylight against Tourney's bulky, wide-tracked display letters. Tourney makes the noise while the text keeps things clear.
gen-tourney-gf-farro: Approachable Farro keeps its ascenders compressed and its strokes free of contrast, so it feels friendly and steady. But Tourney is the one that gets loud, with wide tracking and bulky small letters, while Farro does the quiet, tidy work of sans-serif text.
gen-tourney-gf-fragment-mono: Rulers and nails come to mind: Fragment Mono lays its letters out in a tall, contrast-free row beneath Tourney's bulky, stretched capitals. Tourney brings the swagger and the monospace brings order.
gen-tourney-gf-geist-mono: Technical and tidy, Geist Mono sets fixed-width letters with high lowercase and big side gaps. Tourney earns its keep big and brief, where its wide tracking and bulky small letters can really show off.
gen-tourney-gf-genos: Tightly packed and quick, with a high midline and glyphs that almost kiss, Genos never snags on a closed bowl. Genos keeps the reading smooth under Tourney's wide, hefty, uniform-stroke display lettering.
